newsitem.title: USA: Education Alternatives Inc Q2 Dec 31 net.
newsitem.headline: Education Alternatives Inc Q2 Dec 31 net.

text.p: 1996 six months revenue consists primarily of tuition from the company's two private schools.

1995 results included revenues and expenses associated with Baltimore and Hartford school management and consulting contracts. These public school contracts were canceled during the third quarter of fiscal 1996 and had no impact on the Company's results for the six months ended December 31, 1996.

Results for the three and six months ended December 31, 1996, include settlement proceeds of $313,000 and $938,000, respectively, received from the company's investment management firm, which agreed to pay the company $1,250,000 to resolve all remaining issues relating to the firm's management of the company's investment portfolio. The remaining settlement proceeds of $312,000 will be recorded in income during fiscal 1997 when they are received.
